after: got a sentence and nothing more (576 of 1,599)
title: When a paper said "it wasn't the price", did it show a number?

parts.label: showed a number or a chart

footnote: Price is one example. We counted every time a paper named something else that could have caused its result: 1,599 times, in 309 of the 389 papers. Some of the 64% point to a chart or a model with no number beside it, so 64% is the most it can be.
